THE SPARK

Why this one?

I like looking at everyday objects and wondering whether they could do something completely different. A toy blaster seemed like a fun place to start experimenting with physical controls.

THE BUILD

How it works

An ESP32 hardware prototype with MPU6050 motion sensing, push buttons, a piezo impact sensor, LEDs and a buzzer. The firmware reads movement and physical inputs and provides immediate sensor and feedback output.

ESP32 · C++ · MPU6050 · Piezo · Arduino IDE

THE COMPONENTS

Inside the project

  • Motion and orientation sensor input
  • Physical impact and button detection
  • LED, buzzer and serial feedback

CURRENT CHAPTER

Progress & evidence

The Arduino sketch is public and the README links to a LinkedIn hardware video.
